latest_release.body:
These are the release notes for ActivityWatch version v0.14.2.

**New to ActivityWatch?** Check out the [website](https://activitywatch.net) and the [README](https://github.com/ActivityWatch/activitywatch/blob/master/README.md).

# Installation

See the [getting started guide in the documentation](https://docs.activitywatch.net/en/latest/getting-started.html).

# Downloads

## Classic distribution

 - [**Windows**](https://github.com/ActivityWatch/activitywatch/releases/download/v0.14.2/activitywatch-v0.14.2-windows-x86_64-setup.exe) (.exe installer)
 - **macOS**: [Intel](https://github.com/ActivityWatch/activitywatch/releases/download/v0.14.2/activitywatch-v0.14.2-macos-x86_64.dmg) | [Apple Silicon](https://github.com/ActivityWatch/activitywatch/releases/download/v0.14.2/activitywatch-v0.14.2-macos-arm64.dmg) (.dmg)
 - **Linux**: [.zip](https://github.com/ActivityWatch/activitywatch/releases/download/v0.14.2/activitywatch-v0.14.2-linux-x86_64.zip) | [.AppImage](https://github.com/ActivityWatch/activitywatch/releases/download/v0.14.2/activitywatch-linux-x86_64.AppImage) | [.deb](https://github.com/ActivityWatch/activitywatch/releases/download/v0.14.2/activitywatch-v0.14.2-linux-x86_64.deb)

## Tauri distribution (experimental — native Wayland support on Linux)

 - [**Windows**](https://github.com/ActivityWatch/activitywatch/releases/download/v0.14.2/activitywatch-tauri-v0.14.2-windows-x86_64-setup.exe) (.exe installer)
 - **macOS**: [Intel](https://github.com/ActivityWatch/activitywatch/releases/download/v0.14.2/activitywatch-tauri-v0.14.2-macos-x86_64.dmg) | [Apple Silicon](https://github.com/ActivityWatch/activitywatch/releases/download/v0.14.2/activitywatch-tauri-v0.14.2-macos-arm64.dmg) (.dmg)
 - **Linux**: [.AppImage](https://github.com/ActivityWatch/activitywatch/releases/download/v0.14.2/activitywatch-tauri-0.14.2-linux-x86_64.AppImage) | [.zip](https://github.com/ActivityWatch/activitywatch/releases/download/v0.14.2/activitywatch-tauri-v0.14.2-linux-x86_64.zip)

# Support ActivityWatch

ActivityWatch is free and open source, with no feature gates. If it is useful to you, [AW Pro](https://activitywatch.net/subscribe/) is an optional subscription that funds ongoing development.

# Contributors

Thanks to everyone who contributed to this release:

@0xbrayo, @andreivince, @erikbjare, @fanxing11, @kvnloo, @RaoufGhrissi, @TimeToBuildBob, @Yarish652, @zachsplat

# Changelog

Changes since [v0.14.1](https://github.com/ActivityWatch/activitywatch/releases/tag/v0.14.1):

 - feat(packaging): ship awatcher in the non-Tauri Linux bundle ([#1531](https://github.com/ActivityWatch/activitywatch/issues/1531)) ([`c8b9203`](https://github.com/ActivityWatch/activitywatch/commit/c8b9203))

### 🐛 Fixes (5)

 - fix(release): harvest signed Linux deb/rpm updater artifacts ([#1542](https://github.com/ActivityWatch/activitywatch/issues/1542)) ([`b4b3bd3`](https://github.com/ActivityWatch/activitywatch/commit/b4b3bd3))
 - fix(release): pass bundle version to the Tauri compilation ([#1535](https://github.com/ActivityWatch/activitywatch/issues/1535)) ([`71cdc78`](https://github.com/ActivityWatch/activitywatch/commit/71cdc78))
 - fix(packaging): pin Qt Wayland watcher substitution ([#1532](https://github.com/ActivityWatch/activitywatch/issues/1532)) ([`5f54ca2`](https://github.com/ActivityWatch/activitywatch/commit/5f54ca2))
 - fix(issue-forms): remove invalid empty title keys ([#1524](https://github.com/ActivityWatch/activitywatch/issues/1524)) ([`33f667d`](https://github.com/ActivityWatch/activitywatch/commit/33f667d))
